description: Accept an exchange-generated order proposal related to a previously submitted purchase demand.
conditions: A purchase demand was submitted through create_purchase_demand and the returned proposal satisfies it.
trade_decision_card.review_queue contains a real proposal awaiting a decision, or the department's proposals_list contains a pending proposal.
blackboard.departments.finance.cash_summary and procurement.self_state.cash_guard show that enterprise funds can cover the proposed order.
parameter_constraints: proposal_id must identify an existing proposal. Prefer trade_decision_card.review_queue; consult the department's proposals_list only if the decision card does not include it.
When creating action.json from this template, action_param must contain exactly the fields listed in required_parameters, with none added or omitted.
constraints: Read blackboard.departments.finance.cash_summary and procurement.self_state.cash_guard before deciding whether to accept.
Do not accept the proposal when cash_guard.guard_level = hard_blocked.
When cash_summary.cash_level = warning, prioritize smaller proposals with more reliable delivery dates that matter most for confirmed or stale backlog.
Warehouse capacity is not currently validated by the system; avoid obviously excessive purchases.
Prefer acceptance when trade_decision_card.review_queue recommends accept_proposal_order for this proposal and quantity, price, and delivery_round show no material conflict.
